episode_definition: Sequential frames 0..200 inclusive cover every available authored observation (0,50,100,150,200) and all intervening history. No warm start at annotation frames. No verified negative interval is available.
hypothesis: Stage provenance on the fixed sequence can distinguish measured support lost before candidates from association/confirmation and distance-definition effects.
criterion: Account for stage execution and measured support for all five provisional observations; choose at most one reproduced cause, retaining baseline outputs and thresholds. Detection accuracy is not established by this panel.
